The following events took place in '''97 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The Bakuran [[Droid Uprising]] occurs, causing the [[Bakuran]]s to develop a distrust of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] as servants.<ref name="Truce" />
*[[Eppie Belden|Eppie Antrusa]] [[Marriage/Legends|marries]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Belden]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="Truce" />
*An [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] acquires a [[sun crystal]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Ewoks 13">[[Ewoks (1985) 13|''Ewoks'' (1985) 13]]</ref>
